name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
summary: Gloves that grant Climb and Swim Speeds and +5 to Athletics checks for them.

stats.effect: While wearing these gloves, you have a {ref:glossary/climb-speed} and a {ref:glossary/swim-speed} equal to your {ref:glossary/speed}, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.
